trello.name: Follow Up with DataBridge on Renewal Terms
trello.desc: Sofia needs to send one final email to the DataBridge account manager today, using plain language to request the revised renewal terms by Thursday close of business. If no reply is received by Thursday COB, Sofia must escalate the issue to the legal department on Friday morning to review termination-for-convenience options. This escalation is triggered automatically by the lack of response, no need to wait for further instructions.

trello.name: Request Dana's Expertise on Security Audit
trello.desc: Sofia will contact Dana from the platform team to review sections 4 and 6 of the recent security audit report, which focus on cryptography and key management findings. Sofia should frame the request as coming from Ravi, and if Dana indicates she doesn’t have the bandwidth, Ravi will escalate the request to Dana's manager.
